findings.title: T002 auto-reworks blocking or conflicting reviews instead of stopping at the required judgment boundary
T001 does not gate runners/orchid-pump before its effectful outbox drain
T002 lacks driver-level criteria and focused tests for configured hooks and non-code or custom archetypes
T002 leaves idempotent task-worktree creation, reuse, and crash recovery underspecified
T003's existing-epoch path lacks a live-lease or concurrent-session refusal criterion and focused fencing test
T005 does not require isolated HOME, XDG, and install prefixes or prove all rehearsal mutations stay disposable
T005's network tripwire omits remote-capable Git operations and vendor or notification CLIs
T002 relies on INV-05 even though it omits runners and several current or future engine identifiers
